newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian O/N rates close lower at 22.625 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian O/N rates close lower at 22.625 pct.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates closed at 22.625 percent, down 0.5 percent from Tuesday's close and traders said they are likely to hover around this level in coming days.
"Present levels slightly below the one-week reverse repo are likely to remain," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank.

The central bank's one-week reverse repo facility came down 0.25 percentage points to 22.75 percent on September 16 and at the time traders said they expect one more cut of a similar size before the end of the year.
